title: Sable
summary: A wardrobe app with its own AI stylist and an MCP server, so agents can work with it as well.
body: I built Sable because I needed one place for everything I wanted to get, and to figure out where I wanted to go with fashion. Then I rebuilt it from the ground up so anyone can make an account: photograph your clothes, save looks, log what you wear and plan what to buy. It installs on your phone and keeps working offline.

One number drives it: how many looks each piece opens, computed from your saved looks and never typed by hand. The Oracle, a Claude-backed stylist, works on your closet through the same operations as the app and reasons with that number when you ask what to buy next.
The same tools are served as a remote MCP server with sign-in, so Claude Desktop or Claude Code can read and update your closet directly.
You can try it without an account: open Sable and choose "Look around the demo closet first". Nothing you change in the demo is saved.
